details.failure_summary: Analytics page missing expected 'Last 24h' preset button
details.reasoning: Clear assertion failure: 'AssertionError: Expected preset button Last 24h to be visible'. The analytics page is not rendering the expected time preset button on default load. This is a specific UI element visibility failure pointing to a product regression, not an infrastructure issue. Other tests in the same run passed, ruling out environment problems.

details.failure_summary: Expired personal token not showing expected expired icon/label (locator count mismatch)
details.reasoning: Clear assertion failure: 'AssertionError: Locator expected to have count 1'. The expired token UI element (icon and/or label) is not present as expected after token expiry. This indicates a product regression in the personal token expiry display logic. The sibling test 'test_invalid_token_name_shows_error_and_keeps_generate_disabled' passed in the same run, confirming the environment was functional.
